task_description: Presentation-only iOS visual polish of the existing, building Heula Next.js PWA: refresh design tokens in globals.css and shared UI primitives, redesign the bottom tab bar into a floating iOS pill (with AppShell + ToastProvider spacing follow-through), and sweep all screens/features for a consistent iOS feel in both light and dark. No version, routing, data-flow, store, Dexie, or copy-string changes. Zero emoji. Icons only via the existing Icon.tsx choke-point (no new IconKeys).
